name: Dina

queries.query: Pakistan official cadastral parcel map Dina Jhelum Punjab land records authority GIS API
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Punjab Land Records Authority (PLRA) and its PULSE land-information viewer. The viewer's current HTML/JavaScript names a Jhelum cadastral-map layer and the Punjab cadastral ArcGIS service. The public service metadata and bounded exact-point query required an ArcGIS token, so no anonymous ID-plus-geometry response was available.

queries.query: پاکستان پنجاب دینہ جہلم سرکاری اراضی ریکارڈ کادسترل نقشہ جی آئی ایس API
queries.result: Urdu/native-language discovery reached the official PLRA/PULSE services and confirmed that land-record access is an official PLRA workflow. The public map is indicative and complete parcel details require login/token access; no credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, identity lookup, ownership lookup, or unsafe field request was used.

registryCustodian.name: Punjab Land Records Authority (PLRA) / Punjab Urban Land Systems Enhancement (PULSE), Government of Punjab
registryCustodian.scope: Provincial land-record and cadastral-map custodian. The official PULSE viewer exposes a Jhelum cadastral-map category and the PLRA-hosted Punjab_Cdastral_Maps ArcGIS service; this is service evidence, not proof of public citywide vector coverage for Dina.

localCustodianContext.name: No separately evidenced Dina cadastral registry endpoint
localCustodianContext.scope: Dina is identified in official Punjab planning material as a municipal area in Jhelum District, but the reviewed material did not evidence a separate city-level parcel service or local registry custodian.

service.name: PULSE public land-information viewer and PLRA-hosted ArcGIS cadastral service
service.viewerConfiguration: The downloaded current PULSE HTML references https://gismaps.punjab-zameen.gov.pk/arcgis/rest/services/VendorMaps/Punjab_Cdastral_Maps/MapServer as the Punjab cadastral layer and lists Jhelum in its cadastral-map options. The viewer displays a login-for-complete-parcel-details notice.
